¶ ARAMAEA lingua eadem, quæ Chaldaica est.
¶ ARMENORVM lingua vulgaris & Turcica est & Tartarica.
main_text.head: Oratio Dominica in linguâ Armenicâ:
main_text.p: CHAIR mer ur hierchins, des frboi ezi- si anoncho. ekesse archaiotaicho. ezifsin chankcho, urbis hierkins,ie etchri. Zachaz mer hanaba gsord tour mez ais anroie touz mer zaabartis mer, urbis ie mech toffumc merus bartbanas.ie mi tanirzame zprtzo tai. ail phirkai zamer izare.Zucho e archaiotai,ie zariotai,ie paouch,auiteaus.Amen.
Armenorum lingua Araxa idem est,quod μισοπάρθεν&, inquit Plutarchus in libro de fluviis: & Axalla Armeniis calidum significat testeStobæo.
Lingua Georgianorum vulgaris Armenicæ & Tartariæ media est: G.Postellus.

page.notes: Greek word "μισοπάρθεν" as printed is uncertain; the last letters of the Greek and the Armenian/Armenicè spellings are as the scan shows. Words such as "phar lana", "hhalena", "cema", "ichtta", "elena" and the whole Armenian Lord's Prayer are copied as printed and may contain printer or scan errors; no [?] was added where the letters were read clearly. The marginal text and the Armenian lines were read from a low-contrast scan, so individual letters in the Armenian prayer are doubtful.
